judgment: The source change pays the commissioned wound: explicit selected-light detail can reveal invisible semantic controls without turning every heartbeat announcement into Unicode bookkeeping.
The change composes existing scene, view-model, accessibility, and OperatorOverlayService organs; it does not create a neighboring parser, renderer, controller, transport, or phone/P0 owner.
The post-projection bound is load-bearing because marker expansion occurs after source acceptance bounds.
Exact scene fields remain canonical evidence; truncated spoken/detail projection must never be described as exact source identity.
Compact and collapsed speech remain deliberately unchanged. That restraint is a feature, not missing work.
The touchable Swan Veil mutation is useful source art but is not Android runtime or delivery evidence.
process_scar: A durable general plan existed before mutation, but no separate Venice plan-review artifact was created pre-mutation. This completion review does not rewrite that history or claim the missing pre-gate existed.
remaining_wound: HeartbeatSceneGraph.Node.detailContentDescription still exposes the older raw bounded detail string even though known explicit detail consumers now use HeartbeatEvidenceDetailProjection. Audit or converge that duplicate semantic field before allowing a new consumer to depend on it.
test_boundary: GitHub Actions workflow-run readback for the source/art head returned integration HTTP 403 Resource not accessible by integration.
